messages:
Lina: Posting the latest mock for the SLO slider + guardrail microcopy. Key asks: how do we show "soft" vs "hard" SLO limits, what keyboard interactions feel intuitive for keyboard-first users, and how do we indicate when autoscale will ignore SLO to meet min capacity? Omar: First pass looks nice. Question: do users understand "soft SLO"? Maybe label as 'SLO target (soft)' and 'SLO floor (hard)'. Soft = preferred latency, hard = strict limit. Becky: Copy nit: 'soft' feels vague in user tests. Propose: 'Target latency (best-effort)' and 'Guardrail (must-meet)'. Keep the guardrail color semantic red/orange if violated. Lina: Good — try 'Target latency (best-effort)' and 'Guardrail (enforced)'. Also we want to show inline reasoning when the system will override target to preserve min capacity: short banner 'Min capacity override: preserving X GPUs' with a docs link. Omar: UX concern: the banner appears when slider crosses a threshold and currently pushes the pool selector down. That causes focus jump for keyboard users. We should pre-allocate the banner area to avoid reflow. Becky: Accessibility: the slider must expose role=slider, aria-valuemin/max/now and aria-valuetext like 'Target: 120ms, Guardrail: 300ms'. When override happens, announce via aria-live polite: 'Autoscale will preserve minimum capacity; target latency may be exceeded.' antibot: A11y scan highlights: missing aria-valuetext on the guardrail handle; contrast of guardrail label 3.4:1; dynamic banner not included in DOM on initial load so some screen readers miss it. Omar: Implementation idea: keep a hidden status region (role=status, aria-live=polite) pre-mounted and update its text on override. Keep focus on the slider. Example snippet: ```
``` Update on change: 'Min override active: preserving 4 GPUs; target latency may be exceeded.' Becky: Keyboard behavior: arrow keys move the active handle by small step, PageUp/PageDown by larger step. Tab cycles handles left-to-right. When override banner appears, do not auto-shift focus. If user presses Enter on tooltip link, open docs in new tab and return focus to the slider. Lina: Visual affordance: add a small lock icon next to min when override is active with aria-label='Min capacity enforced' and make it focusable so keyboard users can read tooltip explaining why. Hit area >=44px. Omar: For the SLO graph above slider: when guardrail violated show subtle pulsing highlight. But ensure motion reduction for prefers-reduced-motion. Also provide numeric readout for screen reader: 'Current latency 340ms, guardrail 300ms, target 120ms.' antibot: Recommended checklist for PR: (1) add aria-valuetext for both slider handles, (2) add pre-mounted role=status region and update on override, (3) improve contrast to >=4.5:1, (4) add focusable lock icon with aria-label, (5) respects prefers-reduced-motion. Becky: I'll update the copy and Figma to use 'Target latency (best-effort)' / 'Guardrail (enforced)' and include the lock icon states. Omar: I'll draft the aria-live patch and unit tests asserting the status text updates and focus stays on slider. Lina: Thanks team 44d Let's reconvene after implementation review. We'll run a short accessibility pass and a 5-person usability check focusing on keyboard-only flow. Becky: +1 Omar: On it.
